title: Twisted Patterson-Sullivan densities on nilpotent covers for Anosov subgroups
summary: Let $Γ<\mathsf{SL}(d,\mathbb R)$ be a torsion-free, Zariski-dense Borel-Anosov subgroup, and let $\varphi$ be a linear functional positive on the limit cone of $Γ$. For every $χ\in \operatorname{Hom}(Γ, \mathbb R)$, we construct twisted $(\varphi,χ)$-conformal densities and prove their existence, uniqueness and ergodicity. For every non-trivial normal subgroup $Γ_0\lhdΓ$ with nilpotent quotient, we classify the ergodic $\varphi$-conformal densities of $Γ_0$ in terms of characters of $Γ/Γ_0$.
